units: pass = GSM8K test strict_dropped (greedy, 1319 problems, those that fit the window); kl = output change, KL(W_t || W0) nats per token over every position of the 128 maths rows at length 256 (E93 clean.W0.K); multiple = kl / masked_error; dw_norm = Frobenius norm of the update over the 196 matrices. Comparisons round to 9 places; a missing value is a miss.

early.source: experiments/qwen_rl/results/predictions.json early (E69), unchanged except the KL band's reference rate, stated
early.kl_first_rule: the band is for a first live step at 1e-6; at rate r it is scaled by (r / 1e-6)^2 (E69 run.py live_checks scales by its tag's lr, which equals 1e-6 at every tag it ran). Expected first-step KL on H: 1e-6w10 ~1.8e-4 (E69 R step 1, band [3e-5, 2e-3]); 3e-6w10 ~1.6e-3 (band [2.7e-4, 0.018]); 1e-5w10 ~0.018 (band [0.003, 0.2])

reproduce.rule: a stop (exit 2) when a value at its step falls outside its band, inclusive; dw_norm bands are E69's seed-0 value +-5% (measured: L40 vs H100 0.013 at step 100, seed 0 vs 70 0.003-0.004 for R), pass bands are E69's seed-0 value +-0.022 (2 binomial se, se ~0.011 over ~1250 problems that fit). kl is an expectation only: a miss is logged and told to the lead, not a stop

reproduce.at_W0: dw_norm 0, pass 0.7817, kl 0: outside every band, so a run that did nothing cannot pass
reproduce.at_control: inside every band (E69's own values are the band centres)

selection.rule: bar = max(the control's pass at step 100 in this run - 0.03, W0's pass). A recipe's read is eligible if its pass >= bar; its level is the largest of 10, 5, 2 that its multiple reaches (>=), else 0. Each recipe's best read: largest level, then fewest steps. Chosen: the recipe whose best read has the largest level; ties go to fewer steps, then the higher pass, then the lower peak rate (order of recipes). outcome 'chosen' if that level is >= 5; 'not reached' (RL could not get there at these recipes: run 2's design goes back to the lead) if it is 2 or no read is eligible at 2x or more; 'incomplete' (no choice read; one repair run may be spent) if any recipe's file lacks done: true or the control has no pass at step 100. A recipe ended by the drift stop is done; its reads after the stop do not exist, and the read that stopped it is below W0's pass, so below the bar.
selection.at_control: the control alone is expected at about 0.7x at step 100 (E93: 0.69) and about 1.5-2.5x at step 250 (if KL grows as |dW|^2 and |dW| reaches ~0.5-0.6): level 0 or 2, so the control by itself is expected not to reach 5x
selection.edge_cases_run: 2026-11-11, ~/commute-data/scratch/qwen-rl-lead/run1-writer/edge.py (results in the plan): no reads, a missing pass, every read under the bar, a tie in level and step, a multiple exactly at 10, W0's pass above the control's minus 0.03, a drift-ended recipe, an unfinished recipe, the control without a step-100 read

drift.rule: R arms only, at each read: pass < W0's pass (0.7817) and kl > the previous read's kl (0 before the first read) -> the arm ends there (done, with 'drift': {step, last_good}); its last good read is the read before. A read with a missing pass or kl is not a drift stop
drift.at_W0: pass equals W0's, not below: no stop
drift.at_control: pass ~0.88 at step 100 (E69): no stop expected at any read to 250
